decisions.reason: The infectious waste plant is a partnered flagship close to the core modular WASTX platform, so it costs little to keep, and its market prospects in medical waste are still resolving, which argues for keeping the option open rather than abandoning it.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant fits directly into the decentralized recycling strategy and existing manufacturing capabilities, and it can be used both as a pretreatment stage and as a stand-alone unit, so keeping it is cheap and its option value remains high.
